sentences.en: I don't know how to legally get around those regulations.
sentences.zh: 我不知道如何合法地规避那些规定。

sentences.en: In Japan, people legally become adults when they turn twenty.
sentences.zh: 在日本，人们在年满二十岁时法律上成为成年人。

sentences.en: Sami is not legally allowed to call or e-mail Layla.
sentences.zh: 萨米没有权利给莱拉打电话或发电子邮件。
